def synthetic_confidence_demo(D_true=0.1, sigma=0.01,
                              n_build=200, n_check=200):
    """已知合成真值下的條件式估計界線與獨立覆蓋診斷。"""
    if (np.ndim(D_true) != 0 or np.ndim(sigma) != 0
            or not np.all(np.isfinite([D_true, sigma]))
            or not 0.01 <= D_true <= 0.5 or sigma <= 0):
        raise ValueError("真值或噪聲尺度不合契約")
    if (not isinstance(n_build, (int, np.integer)) or n_build < 20
            or not isinstance(n_check, (int, np.integer)) or n_check < 20):
        raise ValueError("兩組重複數均須至少 20")
    times = np.array([2.0, 4.0])
    grid = np.linspace(0.01, 0.5, 50)
    predictions = np.exp(-grid[:, None] * np.pi**2 * times)
    truth = np.exp(-D_true * np.pi**2 * times)
    def estimates(seed, count):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        observed = truth + rng.normal(0.0, sigma, (count, 2))
        scores = np.sum((observed[:, None, :] - predictions[None, :, :])**2,
                        axis=2)
        return grid[np.argmin(scores, axis=1)]
    build = estimates(20001, n_build)
    check = estimates(20002, n_check)
    qlo, qhi = np.percentile(build - D_true, [2.5, 97.5])
    lower = np.maximum(0.01, check - qhi)
    upper = np.minimum(0.5, check - qlo)
    return {"construction_repetitions": int(n_build),
            "coverage_repetitions": int(n_check),
            "error_quantiles_m2_s": [float(qlo), float(qhi)],
            "example_interval_m2_s": [float(lower[0]), float(upper[0])],
            "empirical_coverage": float(np.mean((lower <= D_true) &
                                                  (D_true <= upper))),
            "bounds_m2_s": [0.01, 0.5],
            "estimator": "two-time analytic grid least squares",
            "assumption": "known synthetic truth; independent Gaussian noise"}

def synthetic_confidence_demo(D_true, sigma, n_build, n_check,
                              seed_build, seed_check, times_s,
                              D_min, D_max, n_search):
    """已知合成真值下的條件式界線；振幅及噪聲單位為 kg/m^3。"""
    scalars = (D_true, sigma, D_min, D_max)
    if (any(np.ndim(z) != 0 for z in scalars)
            or not np.all(np.isfinite(scalars))
            or not D_min <= D_true <= D_max or D_min <= 0
            or D_max <= D_min or sigma <= 0):
        raise ValueError("真值、噪聲或搜尋範圍不合契約")
    counts = (n_build, n_check, seed_build, seed_check, n_search)
    if (any(isinstance(z, (bool, np.bool_))
            or not isinstance(z, (int, np.integer)) for z in counts)
            or n_build < 20 or n_check < 20 or n_search < 2
            or seed_build < 0 or seed_check < 0
            or seed_build == seed_check):
        raise ValueError("重複數、格點數或種子不合契約")
    times = np.asarray(times_s, dtype=float)
    if (times.shape != (2,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(times))
            or np.any(times < 0) or times[0] == times[1]):
        raise ValueError("需兩個不同的有限非負觀測時間")
    grid = np.linspace(D_min, D_max, n_search)
    amplitude = 1.0  # kg/m^3
    predictions = amplitude*np.exp(-grid[:, None]*np.pi**2*times)
    truth = amplitude*np.exp(-D_true*np.pi**2*times)
    def estimates(seed, count):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        observed = truth + rng.normal(0.0, sigma, (count, 2))
        scores = np.sum((observed[:, None, :] - predictions[None, :, :])**2,
                        axis=2)
        return grid[np.argmin(scores, axis=1)]
    build = estimates(seed_build, n_build)
    check = estimates(seed_check, n_check)
    qlo, qhi = np.percentile(build - D_true, [2.5, 97.5])
    lower = np.maximum(D_min, check - qhi)
    upper = np.minimum(D_max, check - qlo)
    return {"construction_repetitions": int(n_build),
            "coverage_repetitions": int(n_check),
            "error_quantiles_m2_s": [float(qlo), float(qhi)],
            "example_interval_m2_s": [float(lower[0]), float(upper[0])],
            "empirical_coverage": float(np.mean((lower <= D_true) &
                                                  (D_true <= upper))),
            "bounds_m2_s": [float(D_min), float(D_max)],
            "estimator": "two-time analytic grid least squares",
            "assumption": "known synthetic truth; independent Gaussian noise"}
